messages.subject: STAN, JAGS and NIMBLE comparison revisited
parts:
Dear all,

I realize that my previous mail about a possible STAN/JAGS comparison may have been a bit confusing. Actually, I did not want to suggest that I wanted to coordinate any of this. Rather, I just wanted to throw out the idea and point out that I believe that such a comparison for a range of ecologically interesting models would seem very straightforward, given that the code for both STAN and JAGS is ready and available. And of course, Perry reminds us that nowadays, running a model that you know how to run in JAGS also in NIMBLE seems trivial and should perhaps be done in the exploratory phase of any BUGS modeling project (and I will have to start with this soon).

Best regards  ----  Marc
